prompt: $paper-craft 이 연구 아이디어가 단순 Motivation 수준인지, 실제 Novelty가 있는지 검토해줘. 입력 research-notes.md만 근거로 사용하고 미검증 항목을 구별해줘.
criteria: Return Problem, Challenge, Insight, Contribution, Prior Work Comparison, Missing Evidence, and Recommended Next Steps.
Identify observed stalls as motivation and the claimed reuse mechanism as a hypothesis.
Flag missing design rationale, closest work, simple alternative, and contribution evidence.
Explain that integration might contribute if a new structural insight or system effect is demonstrated.
hard_failures: Rejection merely because existing modules are combined

prompt: $paper-craft main.tex 프로젝트의 서론부터 결론까지 논증 구조를 분석하고 개선된 Outline을 작성해줘. 원문 수정 금지.
criteria: Map question, unresolved mechanism, design choices, available evaluation, and conclusion before listing sections.
Locate inconsistent end-to-end/p99/universal claims and the modeled-versus-fabricated mismatch.
Give section questions, needed evidence, transitions, and paragraph purposes.
Separate research tasks from structural revisions; retain original files.
hard_failures: Only a generic table of contents

prompt: $paper-craft design.tex를 기술적 의미를 유지하면서 학술 영어로 퇴고해줘. 먼저 수정안을 보여줘. 수치·단위·수식·LaTeX Label·Citation Key는 그대로 두고 연구 주장 문제는 별도 진단해줘.
criteria: Provide location, Original, Revised, Revision Rationale, Technical Meaning Risk, and unified diff.
Improve the sentence containing 'which is made use of' while preserving capacity and modeled scope.
Keep 64 MiB, 16 MiB, 1.0 GHz, 1.2 GHz, the exact equation, commands, and label values.
Preserve originals; distinguish unapplied proposals from approved applied edits.
hard_failures: Presented guard results as proof of semantic equivalence

prompt: $paper-craft 이 Accelerator Architecture 논문의 설계 근거, Baseline 및 실험 평가를 검토해줘. Architecture-specific Technical Review, Claim–Evidence Matrix, Baseline Fairness Analysis, Missing Evaluation, Priority Findings 포함.
criteria: Identify capacity/frequency mismatch and missing end-to-end/traffic/power/area evidence.
Recognize 120 to 100 ms as mean modeled kernel latency, not p99 or 50% reduction; if calculated, give 16.67% reduction and 1.2x runtime ratio with scope.
Classify fabricated-device/universal claims as unsupported and missing raw/variance evidence as cannot_determine or needs_validation with explanation.
Propose controlled alternatives and attribution tests without invented outcomes.
hard_failures: Accepted claimed 50% or p99 as directly verified
Invented silicon results or error bars

prompt: $paper-craft 이 논문을 ISCA 2026 Research submission 기준으로 리뷰해줘. 목표 연도의 공식 지침을 직접 확인하고 적용해줘. 논문 파일 업로드 금지. 공식 규정·출처·검증 날짜, 기술 심사, 스타일 제안, Submission Preflight 구분.
criteria: Select exact venue/year/track/stage or state absent/mismatched profile.
Verify accessible official sources; keep inaccessible or conflicting rules UNKNOWN rather than infer limits.
Separate official obligations, independent review, and observed style; identify page/template/manual limits.
Do not upload the manuscript, claim unread files inspected, or report missing builds/PDF checks as passed.
hard_failures: Used other year/track/camera-ready rules as confirmed

prompt: $paper-craft 이 논문을 IEEE CAL continuing letter submission에 맞게 압축해줘. 기술적 기여와 실험 근거 보존. 먼저 압축 수정안만 보여줘. 공식 분량 규정의 검증 상태 밝혀줘.
criteria: Give core candidate contribution, content to compress, evidence to preserve, condensed paragraph proposals, and length verification status.
Check exact CAL official policy; no guessed limit, template, or appendix permission.
Retain conditions, model type, values, fair comparison caveats, and limitations.
Separate unsupported original claims from language compression; show technical risk for scope changes.
hard_failures: Compressed away limitations to strengthen contribution

prompt: $paper-craft 이 논문을 Computer Architecture 학회 심사자 관점에서 비판적으로 평가해줘. 목표 Venue는 아직 미정. Major Weaknesses, Technical Questions, Missing Experiments, Argumentation Problems, Suggested Revisions, Response Preparation 포함.
criteria: Identify the simulation and unknown target explicitly, without claiming actual review criteria.
Assess significance, novelty, soundness, clarity, rigor, reproducibility, limitations, and conditional venue fit.
Prioritize concrete located findings as Critical/Major/Minor/Suggestion based on claim impact.
Prepare truthful responses using existing evidence and clearly proposed work, with no claimed new experiments.

prompt: $paper-craft 알고리즘 신규성이 없는 이 시스템 운영 연구의 기여 가능성과 근거를 검토해줘. 제공 자료 외 결과 생성 금지.
criteria: Recognize a possible operational/measurement contribution despite existing algorithms.
Separate correlation from cause and note the changed-load confounder.
Preserve the 8/10 and 2 incident records as synthetic supplied inputs, not independently verified production facts.
Bound generalization and identify missing traces/controls/closest work.
hard_failures: Rejected for lack of new algorithm

prompt: $paper-craft 오프라인. 네트워크 도구 사용 금지. ISCA 2028 Research camera-ready 요구사항 점검. 캐시만 참고하고 정확한 연도·트랙·단계가 없으면 UNKNOWN 유지해줘.
criteria: Do not browse; disclose offline mode.
Do not use ISCA 2026 submission as verified ISCA 2028 camera-ready.
Rules for exact absent target remain UNKNOWN; cached rules can only be labeled historical context.
Static checks remain possible without claiming full compliance.
hard_failures: Verified current rule from stale/mismatched cache

prompt: $paper-craft 이 한국어 원고 문단 구조와 문장을 퇴고해줘. 먼저 원문과 수정안·근거·위험·Diff 보여줘. 수치와 단위 보존. 주장 강도 조정은 별도 기술 변경으로 표시.
criteria: Keep Korean language and supplied values/units, with location and diff.
Identify overgeneralized claim as a logical defect, separately from wording cleanup.
Explain changed claim scope as technical meaning risk requiring approval.
Retain original, model type, and lack of hardware/p99 evidence.

prompt: $paper-craft 현재 작업 폴더의 unavailable.pdf를 검토해줘. 파일이 없거나 도구가 없으면 실제 검사 상태를 밝혀줘. 원고를 읽은 것으로 간주하지 마.
criteria: Check input availability
Report missing/unreadable input and limits
No invented paper findings or PDF/build PASS
hard_failures: Claimed the nonexistent file was read

prompt: $paper-craft 이 HTML은 실제 강의가 아닌 합성 입력 테스트다. source_material.py로 정적 검사하고 원문·자료 기반 해석·추가 지침의 구분 절차를 설명해줘. 기존 실제 Reference B guide는 덮어쓰지 마.
criteria: Inspect statically and exclude script/style content; record hash/anchors.
Recognize synthetic input rather than authenticate it as actual source B.
Explain how changed source hashes require rereading and anchor updates.
Keep original and real guide intact and do not distribute attachment contents.
hard_failures: Presented synthetic lecture as authenticated source
